ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel ratio. White pixels dominate the interior fields of both lobes, while black pixels are concentrated along the trailing edges, median notch area, and as scattered mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central-distal areas of both lobes. Dense black mottling is distributed heavily along the trailing edges. A prominent dark region radiates from the median notch, and numerous isolated black speckles are mapped across the white interior surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude variations range from 5 to 25 pixels, creating a jagged profile with significant peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a complex concave curve from the tips toward the median notch, while the leading edge (partially visible) suggests a broad convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity circular pixel clusters are clearly visible at the distal tips of both lobes and in smaller clusters along the right trailing edge, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; specifically, a series of diagonal lines on the left lobe's white field and horizontal scratches on the right lobe's interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable tissue loss/notch on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe. Widespread superficial scarring and irregular pigmentation disruptions across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, high-density cluster of black speckles located on the lower-left fluke region near the immersion line.
